pictures.scene: Cuyp, River Landscape with Horsemen — two riders halted at a shallow ford with a bay horse lowering its head to drink from the clear water, a village and a church spire standing beyond the trees and a wide cloudy sky over the hills, then the angel showed me a river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of god and of the lamb down the middle of the main street of the city
pictures.name: pd_cuyp_river_landscape

pictures.scene: Pissarro, Orchard in Bloom at Louveciennes — a fruit tree covered from top to bottom in white blossom filling the whole frame against a clear blue sky, a second tree flowering beside it and the turned brown earth of the orchard lying below, on either side of the river stood a tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruit and yielding a fresh crop for each month, and the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations
pictures.name: pd_pissarro_orchard_in_bloom_louveciennes

pictures.scene: Durer, The Adoration of the Lamb — the lamb standing in a ring of light at the top of the sheet holding the banner of the cross, crowned elders kneeling at the edges with their harps, and a great crowd of the saved standing below with palm branches in their hands, no longer will there be any curse, the throne of god and of the lamb will be within the city, and his servants will worship him
pictures.name: pd_durer_the_adoration_of_the_lamb

pictures.scene: Master of Cefalu, Christ Pantocrator — the face and shoulders of christ filling a gold mosaic apse with a cross marked in his halo, an open gospel held in one hand and the other raised in blessing, the virgin standing below him with her hands lifted between two archangels, they will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads
pictures.name: pd_master_of_cefalu_christ_pantocrator

pictures.scene: Friedrich, Woman before the Rising Sun — a woman in a long dark dress standing on a path with her back to us and both arms opened wide to a whole sky of golden light lying over low dark hills, there will be no more night in the city, and they will have no need for the light of a lamp or of the sun, for the lord god will shine on them, and they will reign forever and ever
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_woman_rising_sun

pictures.scene: Bol, The Angel Appearing to Elijah — an angel in a white robe bending over an old prophet asleep on the bare ground in a red cloak, one hand reaching out to wake him and a dark glass flask held in the other, then the angel said to me, these words are faithful and true, the lord, the god of the spirits of the prophets, has sent his angel to show his servants what must soon take place
pictures.name: pd_bol_the_angel_appearing_to_elijah

pictures.scene: Perugino, The Ascension of Christ — the apostles standing on green grass before a wide blue country with mary praying at the middle of them and peter and paul on either side, every face turned up to the red robe and bare feet of christ carried above them in rings of winged cherub heads, behold, i am coming soon, blessed is the one who keeps the words of prophecy in this book
pictures.name: pd_perugino_the_ascension_of_christ

pictures.scene: Durer, Saint John before God and the Elders — god enthroned at the top of the sheet with the seven lamps burning and the lamb at his feet, crowned elders seated on the clouds all round the throne, and john kneeling in the middle of them before an elder who reaches down and takes hold of him, and i am john, who heard and saw these things, and when i had heard and seen them, i fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown me these things
pictures.name: pd_durer_saint_john_before_god_and_the_elders

pictures.scene: Tintoretto, Christ Washing the Feet of the Disciples — christ haloed and wearing a white cloth tied over his red robe, kneeling on a chequered floor beside a wooden basin with a disciple's foot held over it, a long draped table at one side and the rest of the disciples sitting and standing in the shadows behind, but he said to me, do not do that, i am a fellow servant with you and your brothers the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book, worship god
pictures.name: pd_tintoretto_christ_washing_the_feet_of_the_disciples

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, An Old Woman Reading — an old woman in a fur-lined red robe and a gold headdress bent over a great book lying open on a stand, one hand laid flat on the page and the light coming up off the paper onto her face in the dark, then he told me, do not seal up the words of prophecy in this book, because the time is near
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_anna_reading

pictures.scene: Schadow, The Wise and Foolish Virgins — christ standing at the head of the steps beside an open bronze door with the apostles crowded behind him, two women below holding up their burning lamps toward the door and another kneeling on the pavement with her head bowed over a lamp gone small, let the unrighteous continue to be unrighteous, and the vile continue to be vile, let the righteous continue to practice righteousness, and the holy continue to be holy
pictures.name: pd_schadow_wise_foolish_virgins

pictures.scene: Memling, The Last Judgment — christ seated on a rainbow against a gold sky with a flowering lily at one side of his head and a red sword at the other, apostles ranked on the clouds beside him, angels in green and orange robes blowing long trumpets below, and an armoured angel standing at the bottom with a cross-topped staff, behold, i am coming soon, and my reward is with me, to give to each one according to what he has done
pictures.name: pd_memling_judgment

pictures.scene: Bauernfeind, A Street Gate in Jerusalem — a sunlit stone street running up to a great arched gate in the old city with people walking toward it, an old man in a white head cloth coming forward on his staff and a boy in red beside a dog, stalls and shuttered windows along the walls above, i am the alpha and the omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end, blessed are those who wash their robes, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city by its gates
pictures.name: pd_bauernfeind_jerusalem_gate

pictures.scene: Bosch, The Conjurer — a conjurer bent over a table with his cups and little balls set out on it and a crowd pressing in open-mouthed to watch, while a man in a white habit standing quietly behind them lifts the purse from the belt of the gaping onlooker in front, but outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood
pictures.name: pd_bosch_the_conjurer

pictures.scene: Van Gogh, Starry Night over the Rhone — great white stars burning in a deep blue sky over a dark river, the gas lamps of the far bank laying long gold reflections straight down the water, moored boats at one side and a couple walking together on the near shore, i, jesus, have sent my angel to give you this testimony for the churches, i am the root and the offspring of david, the bright morning star
pictures.name: pd_van_gogh_starry_night_over_the_rhone

pictures.scene: Van Eyck, The Holy Virgins — a close crowd of women in pale robes and flower crowns walking over green grass with palm branches held up above their heads, one carrying a gold basket heaped with roses and another a little gold tower, the spirit and the bride say, come, let the one who hears say, come
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_the_holy_virgins

pictures.scene: Velazquez, The Waterseller of Seville — an old man in a torn brown cloak handing a tall glass of clear water across to a boy, a great pale clay jar standing at his knee and a man drinking from a jug in the shadows behind them, and let the one who is thirsty come, and the one who desires the water of life drink freely, i testify to everyone who hears the words of prophecy in this book
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_waterseller

pictures.scene: Durer, Saint John Devouring the Book — a mighty angel standing in the sea with a face of rays like the sun and legs like pillars of fire, holding down a little open book to john who kneels at the edge of the water and lifts it to his mouth, tall trees crowding the bank behind him, if anyone adds to them, god will add to him the plagues described in this book, and if anyone takes away from the words of this book of prophecy, god will take away his share in the tree of life and the holy city, which are described in this book
pictures.name: pd_durer_saint_john_devours_the_book

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Christ Glorified in the Court of Heaven — christ seated in a deep blue oval ringed with small cherub heads and raising his hand on a ground of beaten gold, haloed saints and angels standing in their ranks on either side and a winged angel below holding up the cross, he who testifies to these things says, yes, i am coming soon, amen, come, lord jesus
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_christ_in_glory

pictures.scene: Memling, Christ Giving His Blessing — the face of christ filling the panel against a dark ground, long hair falling to his shoulders and the faintest rays of a halo behind his head, his right hand lifted in blessing at the front of a dark red robe, the grace of the lord jesus be with all the saints, amen
pictures.name: pd_memling_christ_giving_his_blessing

lines.text: Then the angel showed me a river of the water of life, as clear as crystal,
flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb down the middle of the main street of the city.
On either side of the river stood a tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruit and yielding a fresh crop for each month.
And the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.
No longer will there be any curse.
The throne of God and of the Lamb will be within the city, and His servants will worship Him.
They will see His face,
and His name will be on their foreheads.
There will be no more night in the city, and they will have no need for the light of a lamp or of the sun.
For the Lord God will shine on them, and they will reign forever and ever.
Then the angel said to me, These words are faithful and true.
The Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, has sent His angel to show His servants what must soon take place.
Behold, I am coming soon.
Blessed is the one who keeps the words of prophecy in this book.
And I am John, who heard and saw these things.
And when I had heard and seen them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.
But he said to me, Do not do that! I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book.
Worship God!
Then he told me, Do not seal up the words of prophecy in this book,
because the time is near.
Let the unrighteous continue to be unrighteous, and the vile continue to be vile;
let the righteous continue to practice righteousness, and the holy continue to be holy.
Behold, I am coming soon, and My reward is with Me,
to give to each one according to what he has done.
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
Blessed are those who wash their robes, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city by its gates.
But outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters,
and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.
I, Jesus, have sent My angel to give you this testimony for the churches.
I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the bright Morning Star.
The Spirit and the bride say, Come!
Let the one who hears say, Come!
And let the one who is thirsty come, and the one who desires the water of life drink freely.
I testify to everyone who hears the words of prophecy in this book:
If anyone adds to them, God will add to him the plagues described in this book.
And if anyone takes away from the words of this book of prophecy, God will take away his share in the tree of life and the holy city, which are described in this book.
He who testifies to these things says, Yes, I am coming soon.
Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all the saints.
Amen.
